identifiability_findings: Observational samples do not identify a unique recursive circuit: the same positive finite distribution admits flat sum-of-products, ordered decision-diagram and variable-elimination representations.
Circuit-node count is not a representation-independent capability measure; it changes with variable ordering, sharing and compiler conventions.

A synthetic generator authored directly as the target recursive circuit would privilege the proposed mechanism unless a representation-neutral task supplies an independently justified natural factorization.
The proposed decisive signature of a smaller learned circuit therefore cannot by itself distinguish discovery from generator or compiler alignment.

control_semantics_audit.contextual_chow_liu: The EXP-0040 implementation searches one binary selector and then maximum-weight disjoint pair matchings; it is not a general mixture of Chow-Liu trees.
control_semantics_audit.pairwise_factor_elimination: The EXP-0040 implementation learns a maximum-weight degree-one pair factorization and enumerates its components; it is not generic variable elimination.
control_semantics_audit.tensor_train_or_decision_diagram: No registered implementation and conformance fixture exists for this proposed cohort.
control_semantics_audit.privileged_recursive_circuit: No versioned recursive oracle specification or implementation exists for this proposed cohort.

decision_reason: The proposed cohort cannot presently separate a learned recursive principle from equivalent representation choices, and its mandatory strong controls do not exist with the declared semantics. Reusing EXP-0040 names would repeat a control-semantics failure; building a target-shaped generator and several new compilers would optimize a new toy rather than run a minimal discriminating scout.
next_cycle: One minimal protected service migration of the existing raw-sensor active-identification contract to v2 for a source-identical learned posterior-partition decision DAG, support-only DAG and frozen DAG. Preserve data, worlds, splits, metrics, budgets and seven controls; add only role mappings and semantic fixtures. Cycle 177 must then run exactly one quick scout, so the migration must not expand into a framework.
